mapper.insert: insert into "interviewworks_ticket"."user_data" (account, name, email, phone, password, birthday, permissions) values (#{account}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{password}, '', 'USER')
mapper.select: select user_data.account, user_data."name", user_data.email, user_data.phone, user_data."password", user_data.birthday, user_data.permissions from "interviewworks_ticket"."user_data" user_data where account = #{account} or email = #{account}

select permissions.code from "interviewworks_ticket"."user_data" user_data inner join "interviewworks_ticket".permissions permissions on user_data.permissions = permissions.description where user_data.email = #{account}
